purpose.en: Train shoulder blade depression and stability.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，只靠肩胛下沉把身体抬起
text.en: Keep your arms straight and lift yourself by pulling your shoulder blades down

text.zh: 正握单杠，比肩略宽，双腿并拢
text.en: Grip the bar overhand a little wider than your shoulders, legs together.

text.zh: 顶端停1秒，再慢慢回到悬垂
text.en: Hold for one second at the top, then return slowly to the hang.

commonErrors.zh: 弯肘拉起，变成小幅引体向上
commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows so it turns into a small pull-up.

cautions.zh: 悬垂前先确认单杠安装牢固；肩前侧夹痛时缩短时长或改简单版本
cautions.en: Check that the bar is secure first; if the front of your shoulder pinches, shorten the set or use an easier version.
